title: Everrose
description: Craft Everrose, a rose gold alloy surpassing netherite, with gold-speed tools, special foods, and armor trims.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41dbe75b895e8f933c237514fb27240a7b0cb7dc.png)

**Everrose** is inspierd by the rose gold content from one of my early project, with rebalanced stats and additional features so it works fine on its own in vanilla.



| Recipe of Raw Everrose | How to Duplicate Templates |
| ---- | ---- |
| ![Recipe of Raw Everrose](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3a026e2da99897c9c58c2682a0cbe6f39cdf3e1.png) | ![How to Duplicate Templates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01aabc01b6427de64dfb64d890549a93748a7935.png) |

- **Materials**: 7 Gold Ingots+ 1 Copper Ingot+ 1 Netherite Ingot= 2 **Raw Everrose Ingots**
## Gea
Everrose armor and tools are made in the Smithing Table from their Netherite counterparts, Everrose Ingots, and an upgrade template. Armor offers higher protection, toughness, and knockback resistance than Netherite. Tools match Netherite durability and gold-tier mining speed.

## Food
Everrose Apples, Everrose Carrots, Studded Everrose Roots, etc. Each grants some status effects when eaten.
